text:
maria: heads up — after the q4b quant smoke run this morning we have an unexpected regression on the golden promptset. overall pass rate down ~6pts for intent detection. wondering if the recent dedupe reshuffle could've skewed the holdout.
chen: ugh, that timing aligns w/ the dedupe job that landed at 06:12. i can check the sampler logs — might be a shard/seed rotation effect.
sam: label ops here — current queue is ~48 hrs at normal throughput but we can prioritize a small rerun if we pin a reduced sample. how big is the delta sample we need?
maria: thanks. olivia ran a quick eval: 2000 exemplar prompts, topdrop mostly on short-context system prompts and a subset of multi-intent synths. i think a focused ~300 case golden retest should be enough to triage.
olivia: yep, i exported the failure slice -> `gs://redwood-curation/q4b-smoke/171305-fails.csv`. pattern looks like: (a) prefix truncation, (b) entity normalization edgecases, (c) ranking swaps.
chen: i pulled sampler trace: the seed rotation changed bucket assignment for ~12% of the sample. sampler cmd:```bash
python sample_bank.py --seed-bridge --cohort=golden --limit=300 --rotate-seed=on
```
if we revert rotation for this rerun, we can isolate whether dedupe->sampling changed distribution.
sam: we can take a prioritized micro-label job. will need a mapping file and rubric. pinging label-bot to queue. @label-bot can you create a microtask for `q4b-golden-300` with high priority?
label-bot: queued microtask `q4b-golden-300` -> task_id 20260317-9, ETA ~24h, assignees auto-alloc. react with :eyes: to bump to expedited.
maria: perfect. sam, can you create a quick rubric thread for the three failure modes? keep it 1-2 bullets per case.
sam: will do. draft rubric: 1) intent-presence — mark if primary intent missing; 2) entity canonicalization — prefer normalized form in answer; 3) ranking — if multiple valid answers, prefer earlier human-labeled canonical. uploading doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/curation/q4b-golden-rubric (internal)
olivia: i'll also run a head-to-head on the pre-dedupe artifact snapshot so we have control. need the exact sampler args; if chen can regenerate the pre-rotation sample hash we can diff.
chen: i saved the pre-rotation hash: `sha256: b7f3a9c2...`. regen with `--seed=42 --rotate-seed=off` to match.
maria: timeline proposal: (1) chen regen sample with rotation off by EOD, (2) label-bot microtask runs overnight, (3) olivia runs eval on both samples tomorrow morning and posts bench. if regression persists -> escalate to quant kernel team.
sam: noted. also heads-up: we have two contractors available tonight, i'll allocate them to the microtask to speed up.
olivia: small ask — can we log the model + compile flags used in the smoke run? i suspect an operator-level kernel fallback happened during the run. sample of config:```json
{"model":"q4b-v2","compile_flags":["int4-fast-matmul","kvcache-swap"],"max_ctx":2048}
```
maria: added to the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-3281. i'll link eval outputs and sampler diffs.
chen: starting the regen now, will drop artifacts to the bucket + post hash here when done.
sam: rubric posted and assignees set. label-bot says we can fasttrack if someone reacts. please react to the microtask msg in channel when you want expedite.
label-bot: update -> microtask expedited (react detected). assigned to contractor-team-2.
maria: thanks all — after olivia posts the bench, let's do a 30m check-in at 09:30 PT to decide next steps. @sam can you own the label handoff?
sam: yep i'll own it.
chen: pre-rotation sample hash uploaded: `sha256: b7f3a9c2d1e8f0a2c3b4e5f67890abcd1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef`. bucket: `gs://redwood-curation/q4b-smoke/regen-171305`.
olivia: evals queued, i'll post short TL;DR + full csv. if we see the same failure modes on pre-rotation -> it's likely quant/regression; if only on rotated -> sampling.
maria: :thumbsup: great. small note: capture latency traces too (we saw an odd spike earlier). add `--trace=lite` to eval command.
olivia: will do.
maria: closing the loop — thanks team, appreciate the evening sprint.
